keywords: EIP-8250 keyed nonce 地址固定
summary: 两个与账户和隐私相关的 EIP 把系统合约地址写进规范：EIP-8250 的 `NONCE_MANAGER` 固定为 `0x...8250`，EIP-8272 的 `RECENT_ROOT_ADDRESS` 固定为 `0x...8272`，让 devnet 可以按规范互通。Marchhill 提交 EIP-8361 交易有效性证明，用证明抬高公共内存池对 frame 交易验证工作的上限。晚上 ACDT #90 讨论 Glamsterdam 重定价，锚点从 100 降到 75 Mgas/s。

items.topic: keyed nonce 与 recent root 系统合约地址落地
items.title: EIP-8250：固定 NONCE_MANAGER 为 0x...8250
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）合并。PR 说明 `NONCE_MANAGER` 的地址决定 keyed nonce 所在的存储槽，两个客户端选了不同的值就不在同一条链上；此前地址是 `0xTBD`，而合约代码已经固定。已知的两个实现都独立选择了与 EIP 编号相同的地址，这与 EIP-8141 中 `EXPIRY_VERIFIER = 0x...8141` 的惯例一致。
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), merged. The PR explains that `NONCE_MANAGER`'s address determines the storage slots keyed nonces live in, so two clients that pick different values do not share a chain; the address was `0xTBD` while the contract code was already pinned. Both known implementations independently chose the address equal to the EIP number, matching the `EXPIRY_VERIFIER = 0x...8141` convention in EIP-8141.

items.topic: 用证明扩展 frame 交易的内存池预算
items.title: EIP-8361：交易有效性证明
items.note: （Marchhill）提交。PR 说明：对 EIP-8141 验证前缀生成证明，可以抬高公共内存池的验证工作上限，并扩展 FOCIL 资格，而不改变交易执行和 gas 收费；包括递归批量、受限的 fee-bump 复用、有界的证书获取，以及每个 IL 一份经认证的证书。目标是本地消费级证明和未来能验证证明的节点。
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted. Per the PR, proofs of EIP-8141 validation prefixes raise the public mempool's validation-work ceiling and extend FOCIL eligibility without changing transaction execution or gas charges. It includes recursive batching, restricted fee-bump reuse, bounded certificate retrieval and one authenticated certificate per IL, and targets local consumer proving and future proof-verifying nodes.

items.title_en: Eli Ben-Sasson: ZK is now the consensus answer for scaling blockchains, so which ZK topics are worth explaining

summary_en: Two account and privacy EIPs wrote their system contract addresses into the spec: EIP-8250's `NONCE_MANAGER` is pinned to `0x...8250` and EIP-8272's `RECENT_ROOT_ADDRESS` to `0x...8272`, so devnets can interoperate by reading the spec. Marchhill submitted EIP-8361 transaction validity proofs, which use proofs to raise the public mempool's ceiling on validation work for frame transactions. In the evening ACDT #90 discussed Glamsterdam repricing, with the anchor lowered from 100 to 75 Mgas/s.
